scope: All38 successor reassessments,33 changed full decisions and all26 exact isolated payloads; primary evidence and full frozen recipe context checked. Narrow delta only; no whole-owner/global mapping/export release.

case_reviews.notes: Read DSMZ1752 complete original recipe: Biomaris liquid alternative and separately formulated salt replacement are distinct; no salt recipe was copied into bottled seawater.

Checked all28 frozen recipe bodies and complete occurrence partition. Potato input mass is not retained extract composition; peeled/cut qualifiers select the narrower preparation. Generic tissue owner must remain a material class without implied unpeeled state.
TOGOM2231 separately lists CO2 and sterile air and its comment specifies5% CO2-containing sterile air. Carrier-only scope is explicit, with no invented standard air percentages or liquid dose.

NBRC13 explicit natural/artificial alternatives are real, but the new2%-salinity material-class owner for101/105 does not assert either origin. Requested consistent source binding or a concrete scope distinction.

Read NBRC355 acid coagulation/centrifugation and JCM162/DSMZ775 whey inputs. Seven occurrence bindings partition correctly; milk and HCl remain process inputs, not retained components. Generic-whey vs acid-preparation overlap needs explicit class-level interpretation.
NBRC985 names sterilized natural seawater with Porphyra. Sterile natural-water material is retained without asserting method, dose or tissue composition.
NBRC15 original instructions use300ml V8 plus3gCaCO3 then centrifugation and200ml supernatant. No initialCaCO3 concentration or wholejuice mass is asserted in the output.
NBRC16/17/24/1114 each explicitly name cornmeal extract2g. Cornmeal tissue and complete agar are distinct; extraction chemistry/yield is honestly absent.
NBRC335 natural filtered-aged water OR DaigoSP remains a genuine unresolved alternative. No arbitrary selection of one treatment/product was made.
Manufacturer C9322 COA confirms bovine-liver lyophilized enzyme and activity specification. The lot3190units/mg and86%protein are not generalized; existing CAS/MeSH broad relation remains unchanged.
JCM730 complete recipe places2g malted wheat meal among input materials for rye-bran extraction, followed by centrifugation/filtering. Proposal denotes meal input only, not resulting extract.
DSMZ1054 primary explicitly allows Biomaris089/natural/artificial source water. DSMZ1752 branded material cannot resolve the selected branch; hold is source-specific.
Uncatalogued beef catalase may share generic enzyme owner but cannot inherit C9322 suppliedform/activity; successor prose and proposal limit that application correctly.
TOGOM3127 has MJ base followed by separate MMJ modifications. Opaque base is supported; cited newly retrieved literature must be linked by exact evidence IDs before final approval.
TOGOM2313 lists oat-spelt xylan as one alternative substrate among many. Botanical preparation is separated from larch/beech xylan without invented purity or CAS.
TOGOM1886 primary explicitly gives1L seawater at3% salinity. Opaque salinity-qualified scope is preserved without equating percentage toNaCl or choosing origin.
JCM52 and NBRC304 explicitly specify powdered QuakerWhiteOats3g; NCIT colloidal/fine-powder identity remains a whole-owner hold. Added form is narrower than any unresolved owner reidentification.
NBRC1429 original ingredient is1L seawater1.75% salinity; no dilution from a guessed starting salinity or NaCl equivalent is introduced.
JCM1216 complete primary recipe gives artificial seawater0.1x but omits the1x recipe. Source-qualified stock remains opaque, distinct from existing documented0.5x/1x/4x recipes.
NBRC14 names corn/fish meal feed before boiling and filtration. Qualitative partial corn/fish inputs describe feed itself; they are not asserted as retained extract masses.
DSMZ1008 names charcoal-filtered natural seawater800ml plus separate200ml water; Biomaris substitute is not an identity assertion. Process qualifier and input/output distinction preserved.
JCM995 and NBRC1347 name aged seawater; Hutner stock references do not establish aging protocol. No sterilization or salinity silently added.
NBRC15/16/22/24/1071 support2%-salinity material class. Case22 requires consistent handling as an alternative within that class; no molecular concentration is justified.
All7 peeled/cut potato occurrences partition to prepared tissue, not extract. Unstated piece dimensions are not equated to diced-potato product.
Capitalization counterpart of101 shares2%-salinity class; preserving this shared owner avoids duplicate records. Case22 consistency remains the related open review finding.
Powdered Quaker form is supported only by JCM52/NBRC304. Generic oatmeal uses cannot inherit particle-size processing; whole-owner NCIT hold remains.
NBRC336 permits filtered aged water OR DaigoSP. No exact formulation is selected and no mixture of both is invented.

TOGOM2843 explicitly denotes extract from200g boiled potato, not retained200g solids. Existing Infusion_From_Potatoes already denotes aqueous potato preparation; source-name difference alone does not establish a new substance.
NBRC984 explicitly identifies Porphyra yezoensis thalli cultivated in IMK seawater. No claim of harvested dry/clean tissue or retained medium amount is added.
JCM99 explicitly names Sigma larchwood xylan. Existing owner is promoted with original history and botanical preparation scope; generic CHEBI xylan is not asserted exact.
Generic catalase case receives shared-owner binding only; C9322 supplier form remains limited to catalog-supported42. Human NCIT product remains excluded.
DSMZ789 uses20g diced potato as decoction input, filters it out and restores1L. Prior historical200g claim is not adopted; tissue owner and filtrate remain separate.
Generic KG potato input does not justify infusion identity or a universal preparation mass. Bounded tuber material is distinguished from source-specific processed output.
DSMZ440 explicitly names bovine horn meal10g and separate skim milk. Product scope is horn meal, not purified keratin or horn/hoof mixture.
JCM248 starts with50g dry cow manure, then boils and filters. Existing dry-input owner already fits; extract output does not require changing that input identity.
KG charcoal-filtered natural-water source is reconciled with93 in one owner; no duplicate from source-system spelling or wrong frozen unit.
Generic DSMZ425 oatmeal and its flakes are not all powderedQuaker or NCITfinecolloidal material. Source-form annotation does not release the whole owner.
KG malted-wheat source shares JCM730 input identity with45; meal is kept distinct from finished rye-bran extract and malt extract.

additional_review_note: Generic cheese-whey class versus explicitly acid-prepared whey must remain class/preparation scope, not an assertion of disjoint chemistry or source-defined exact equivalence. No apparent original-capture hash drift was found.
